## Description
Describe your changes and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Refactor (code structure improvements without behavioral changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Build configuration

## Testing Performed
- [ ] Backend tests passed (`python backend/tests/test_verify.py && python backend/tests/test_incognito.py && python -m backend.tests.test_cache`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly with typecheck (`bun run build`)
- [ ] Verified manually in browser / Docker

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project guidelines (TypeScript only for frontend, Conventional Commits)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation / README where needed
- [ ] My commits use Conventional Commits format
